articleTitle: Dynamic Deployment Model of Lightweight Honeynet for Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 6G Communications and IoT Technologies (6GIoTT)
abstract: Distributed honeynet is an important active defense system in the application scenario of Internet of Things. It is a long-term challenge to enhance the deception of honeynet to intruders. In order to increase the deception of distributed honeynets and weaken the attack power of intruders, this paper proposes to dynamically deploy lightweight honeypots near the terminal devices of the Internet of Things, and adjust the vulnerability footprints of real devices and fake honeypots in real time by combining the moving target defense strategy, so as to realize the real-time change of distributed honeynets topology and state. This method increases the complexity of attacks on IoT devices, and reduces security risks by increasing the attack cost of IoT intruders.

articleTitle: Signal Detection Of MIMO System With One bit ADCs Based On Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 6G Communications and IoT Technologies (6GIoTT)
abstract: The massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) with one-bit analog-to-digital converters (ADCs) is a promising technique for the new generation of green mobile communications, which effectively reduces the power consumption and complexity of the massive MIMO communication system. But the performance loss of the massive MIMO system using conventional detection algorithms is severe because of the one-bit ADCs. Since deep learning has great performance advantages in dealing with nonlinear problems, we propose a deep learning (DL)-based detection algorithm and design a new loss function. but there is still a certain gap between DL-based detector and ML detector, for this reason, the result of the DL-based detector is further optimized based on the idea of Hamming distance. The simulation results show that the DL-based detector and two-stage detector is better than many other algorithms, and the proposed loss function is better than MSELoss in this task.

articleTitle: Modified Hybrid Inverse Continuous Modes With a Phase-Shifted Parameter for Designing Broadband Power Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 6G Communications and IoT Technologies (6GIoTT)
abstract: A modified hybrid inverse continuous modes (HICM) is proposed in this paper for designing broadband power amplifiers (BPAs). The proposed continuous working mode expands the design space of the inverse continuums through adding a phase-shifted parameter into the current waveform formula. As a proof of concept, a 3.3–4.3 GHz BPA is designed, simulated and measured in this paper. The measured saturation power and gain of the fabricated power amplifier are 39.1–41.8 dBm and 8.1–10.4 dB over 3.3–4.3 GHz. Meantime, the saturation drain efficiency of the fabricated BPA is 52%–71% in the interested frequency band. Moreover, the fabricated power amplifier achieves adjacent channel leakage rates of −33.3 and −55.7 dBc at 4.2 GHz before and after digital predistortion, respectively.

articleTitle: PSO-Based Low-SLL Pattern Synthesis for FDA in Range-Angle Space
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 6G Communications and IoT Technologies (6GIoTT)
abstract: Frequency diversity arrays (FDAs) have been widely concerned recently because of its flexible signal processing capability. Unlike the phased array, which changes the beam direction by controlling the phase difference, FDA achieves beam control with higher degrees-of-freedom (DOFs) by adopting a tiny frequency offset between adjacent elements. In this paper, a particle swarm optimization (PSO)-based pattern synthesis method is proposed for FDA. The transmission energy is concentrated in the region of interest by subarray, and the low sidelobe beam pattern can be realized. Simulation results show that the synthetic beampattern has −30dB sidelobe in range-angle space. In addition, this method has potential in the suppression of range-related, or range-angle-related clutter and / or interferences.

articleTitle: Application of Two-Dimensional Semiconductor Photoelectric Material in Photodetector
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 6G Communications and IoT Technologies (6GIoTT)
abstract: Two-dimensional semiconductor optoelectronic materials have attracted considerable attention in various disciplines due to their excellent transport properties of electronic devices and structural properties of materials. Wireless sensor network research has great scientific significance and application prospects, and collaboration technology is an important part of it. In this paper, the application of graphene, a two-dimensional semiconductor electronic material, in photoelectric detectors based on Internet collaboration technology is discussed, and some promising research directions in wireless sensor network collaboration technology are prospected.

articleTitle: A Carrier Tracking Algorithm Based on Signal Dynamic Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 6G Communications and IoT Technologies (6GIoTT)
abstract: In the satellite communication system, the phase jitter caused by the dynamic stress error and thermal noise makes the demodulation loss obvious when the carrier tracking of the large dynamic signal is carried out at low SNR, to solve this problem, a carrier tracking algorithm based on dynamic signal estimation is proposed. At first, the signal is roughly estimated and compensated by using the FFT algorithm and FFT analysis of delay correlation, and then the signal is tracked by the third-order phase-locked loop (PLL), the algorithm is improved and simulated. The simulation results show that this method can achieve stable carrier tracking with a symbol rate of 1 Mbps and a tracking rate of 150 kHz/s at a carrier-to-noise ratio of 63 dBHz, and the demodulation loss is less than 0.3 dB. By using this algorithm, the carrier tracking complexity can be reduced and the tracking precision can be improved, which provides a basis for the improvement of the carrier tracking module of the receiver.

articleTitle: A Message Passing Algorithm for Off-grid DOA Estimation Based on UWB System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 6G Communications and IoT Technologies (6GIoTT)
abstract: The Ultra Wideband (UWB) technology has attracted extensive attention and is of great significance for positioning. Direction of arrival (DOA) estimation can improve positioning accuracy of UWB. At present, most researches on DOA estimation algorithms are based on sparse Bayesian learning (SBL) framework. This paper mainly proposes a solution for off-grid DOA estimate of UWB system. We introduce Dirichlet process (DP) prior to cluster the source UWB signals. To describe the problem, we design a factor graph. Mean field (MF) rule is used for the factor graph and a message passing algorithm is obtained. Experimental results prove that the algorithm proposed in this paper is superior.

articleTitle: The generation and test method of User-defined standard OFDM signal based on graphic wizard
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 6G Communications and IoT Technologies (6GIoTT)
abstract: Focusing on the complexity of OFDM(Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing) signal structure and no general OFDM signal generation method and test method being available, and basing on the analysis of the typical OFDM signal physical layer structure, this paper proposes a generation and test method of user-defined standard OFDM signal based on the graphic guide, which has strong universality and convenience for non-standard OFDM signal generation and testing. Then, the vector signal generator and spectrum analyzer are used to test and verify the result, and the importance of time and frequency synchronization to non-standard OFDM signal test is given. This paper provides strong support for development of communication technology.

articleTitle: Study on the Performance Impact and Implementation of Hardware Prefetch Technology in memory Subsystems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 6G Communications and IoT Technologies (6GIoTT)
abstract: “Memory wall” has always been an important bottleneck restricting the further improvement of the processor performance. In order to resolve this limitation, the hardware pre-fetch technology is introduced into the processor as an important supplement to the multi-level Cache technology. As the two most commonly used data prefetch technologies, Stride prefetch and page prefetch have different implementation characteristics and performance influence. In this paper, different prefetch designs are implemented on the FPGA platform. By loading the operating system, running the real tests set(SPEC2006), and further analyzing the performance impact of different hardware prefetch mechanisms on different programs, by analyzing the memory characteristics and performance changes of related test questions.Experiments showed that the improvement achieved by the Stride prefetcher and the page prefetcher fusion was the most obvious, with 22.18% and 33.42% improvement in the L1D and L2 Cache Miss rates, respectively. However, at the same time, due to the differences in the access characteristics of the program, the pre-fetch mechanism brings significant execution delay to some programs, and the execution delay of some questions deterior. It shows that only by realizing the real adaptation of the data prefetch function and the overall function can the hidden effect of the data prefetch on the memory latency be fully realized to maximize the processor performance.

articleTitle: Certificateless Aggregate Signature Authentication Scheme based on Blockchain in Smart Home Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 6G Communications and IoT Technologies (6GIoTT)
abstract: The low delay of edge computing can endue home network with all kinds of intelligence and services. However, the existing centralized security authentication mechanism for smart home network still has some problems such as confidentiality and integrity. In the edge computing environment of smart home network, the distributed authentication scheme with high delay is not suitable for this network environment. In order to reduce the network delay, this paper introduces the aggregation signature authentication mechanism without certificate in the process of smart terminal (ST) authentication (CASAB). The smart gateway (SG) needs to generate a signature representing multiple smart terminals, and the edge server (ES) only needs to verify the signature to realize the identity authentication of multiple smart terminals. The security and performance analysis show that this method is safe and efficient.

articleTitle: A Distributed Network Monitoring And Positioning System Based On TDOA
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 6G Communications and IoT Technologies (6GIoTT)
abstract: In this paper, a distributed network monitoring and positioning system based on TDOA is proposed to solve the problem of radio location, and the system performance test results are given. The system builds a miniaturized and flexible monitoring and positioning network by deploying multiple spectrum sensing nodes, so as to locate the target radiation source, which has certain mobility and practicability.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Voting Rule in the Presence of SSDF Attack in Interweave Cognitive Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 6G Communications and IoT Technologies (6GIoTT)
abstract: Cognitive radio (CR) is widely recognized as a viable solution for spectrum underutilization. Cooperative spectrum sensing (CSS) is a core aspect of CR that improves spectrum sensing performance through spatial diversity. Howeverr, CR provides malicious users (MUs) to launch spectrum sensing data falsification (SSDF) attacks, thus degrading the performance of CSS. And the reporting channel from secondary users (SUs) to the fusion center (FC) consumes significant communication overhead in large CR networks (CRNs), thus reducing CSS efficiency. In front of this issue, we take voting rule in the presence of SSDF attack into consideration to enhance the security and efficiency of CSS. To this end, we make an in-depth analysis on conventional voting rule (CVR) and sequential voting rule (SVR) in an interweave CRN and propose a sequential 0/1 (S0/1) rule to reduce the number of samples. Furthermore, the closed-form performance expressions of S0/1 are also theoretically derived in the absence or presence of SSDF attack. Finally, in contrast to CVR and SVR, numerical simulation results show that the proposed S0/1 is able to maintain the same CSS performance and better CSS efficiency in the presence of SSDF attack.

articleTitle: Hardware in-loop Test Platform for V2X Functioning Verification of Internet of Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 6G Communications and IoT Technologies (6GIoTT)
abstract: Based on the function and performance testing requirements of IoV(Internet of Vehicles), a design scheme of automatic simulation test and verification platform for IoV based on cellular network and real network in-loop was proposed. Firstly, we expounds the overall structure of the simulation test platform and the specific function of each component. Then we discussed the main and functional components of the real cellular network simulation subsystem. Finally, two typical application test scenarios are designed and listed, namely, remote startup delay test of vehicle based on cloud platform and IoV resident performance test of different frequency cell switching under dynamic scenario. Experimental results verify that the simulation test platform can meet the test verification, performance evaluation and troubleshooting capabilities of IoV function. It is of positive significance to improve the application experience of intelligent connected vehicles and IoV.

articleTitle: Multi-sensor Iterative Decision Feedback Equalization Based on Joint Channel Parameters Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 6G Communications and IoT Technologies (6GIoTT)
abstract: For the joint equalization problem of multi-sensor signals over frequency selective fading channels, a new iterative decision feedback equalization scheme is proposed based on joint channel parameters estimation. Firstly, the multi-sensor joint equalization structure is proposed following iterative block decision feedback equalizer (IBDFE), and the equalizer coefficients are computed under minimum mean square error (MMSE) criterion. In each iteration, given the new equalizer output, multiple unknown channel parameters are jointly estimated by means of variational Bayesian (VB) based on minimum relative entropy criterion. The proposed approach operates iteratively between channel estimation and multiple channel equalization. Finally, the performance of the proposed algorithm is analyzed by computer simulations.

articleTitle: Compressed Lightweight Network for Edge Intelligence AMC of CPM Signals
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 6G Communications and IoT Technologies (6GIoTT)
abstract: Automatic Modulation Classification (AMC) is the core technology of physical layer analysis for satellite communication signals. Our investigation found that deep learning methods are widely used in the AMC. However, deep learning requires a huge amount of computation. It brings difficulties to apply in edge devices that require high timeliness. Therefore, this paper proposes a low-complexity compressed lightweight network (CLNet) for the edge intelligence AMC problem of the MIL-STD-188-181C satellite communications protocol. In the feature extraction part, a parallel structure is designed to process channel information and spatial information respectively. In addition, this paper effectively reduces the model complexity through channel compression and stepwise convolution. Finally, the classification result is output by the full connection layer judgment. The paper results that the network parameters of CLNet are about 15.80% of the Residual Network (ResNet), but the classification accuracy is only lower than 1.14%. Compared with other methods, CLNet classification accuracy has significant improvement.

articleTitle: An Iteratively closed-form solution to passive localization by a single moving observer using TOA only with unknown SRI
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 6G Communications and IoT Technologies (6GIoTT)
abstract: An iteratively closed-form solution to passive localization by a single moving observer only using time of arrival (TOA) only with unknown signal repetition interval (SRI) is investigated in this paper. The proposed algorithm includes three main stages. In the first stage the initial value of SRI and SRI integer are obtained by neglecting the signal propagation delay in the TOA model. In the second stage the emitter position is obtained by a closed-form solution using the estimated SRI and SRI integer. An improved SRI is obtained by a least square estimator (LSE) using the TOA compensated by the estimated emitter position in the third stage. The second and third stage are repeated to achieve higher precision. The effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Deployment Schemes of In-Band Management Mode Based on Industrial SDN Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 6G Communications and IoT Technologies (6GIoTT)
abstract: When software defined network (SDN) is used to deploy the industrial control network, the deployment schemes are different in actual according to the different industrial production business, environment and capital cost. In this paper, we use the in-band management mode to deploy the SDN network in an industrial environment. We design four deployment schemes of the in-band management mode for the industrial SDN network according to the specific requirements of industrial environment and propose an algorithm for controller location selection in the in-band management network. For the four schemes and the algorithm, we use the controller and switches to build a simulation environment according to different schemes and compare the performance between the in-band management and out-of-band management, which shows that the in-band management mode can set up a normal SDN industrial network with applicable network scale and throughput.

articleTitle: Analysis of APT Attack Source Tracing in Industrial Internet Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 6G Communications and IoT Technologies (6GIoTT)
abstract: With the development of industrial control systems (ICS), advanced persistent threat (APT) attacks have become one of the important security threats faced by ICS. In recent years, APT attacks against industrial control systems are common. As an important means to improve active network security defense, APT attack source tracing can improve the timeliness and effectiveness of the defense. This paper introduces the current situation, characteristics and problems of APT attack source tracing in the industrial control system. Based on the introduction of the APT attack source tracing of traditional business systems, we discuss the attack methods and source tracing methods of APT attacks under industrial control system. Besides, the current APT source tracing methods also be reviewed. We clarify the current difficulties and challenges of APT attack source tracing and propose corresponding solutions, which could provide a reference for the key infrastructure industry to trace the source of industrial control APT attacks.

articleTitle: Reliable Synchronization Technology for Continuous Variable Quantum Key Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on 6G Communications and IoT Technologies (6GIoTT)
abstract: Data synchronization is a critical technique for subsequent signal processing and secret key extraction of continuous variable quantum key distribution (CVQKD). In this paper, we propose a four-segment synchronization frame structure for CVQKD data synchronization at the first attempt. In order to verify the effectiveness of the structure, we build a data synchronization model containing device noise and fiber nonlinear noise. Simulation results indicate that the synchronization structure can effectively resist the influences of device electronic and fiber nonlinear noise, which is characterized by strong noise immunity, high reliability and easy implementation. The probability of bit synchronization and frame synchronization is 0.44 and 0.76 respectively when link distance is 50km.
